title: C: Lexer/Tokenizer
description: Build a lexer that tokenizes a simple programming language with keywords, identifiers, numbers, and operators.

steps.title: Token Types and Lexer
steps.description: Define token types as an enum: KEYWORD, IDENTIFIER, NUMBER, OPERATOR, LPAREN, RPAREN, EOF. Write a `Token` struct with type and value. Implement `Token next_token(char **input)` that tokenizes a string. Test with 'let x = 42 + y'.

verification.failureMessage: Tokenize 'let x = 42 + y' and print all tokens
